Drought Hits Karnataka and Maharashtra, Farmers Face Crop Losses and Distress

Farmers in Karnataka and Maharashtra are facing severe distress due to drought conditions, with crop losses mounting. In Karnataka, the government has announced the first installment of Rs 2,500 for affected farmers. Meanwhile, in Maharashtra, officials in Latur are inspecting irrigation projects amidst a looming fodder crisis. Reports indicate that farmers in Maharashtra are resorting to selling cattle as their crops fail, with 265 talukas reportedly affected.
